classification.ownership: Harmony host owns PeerConnectionFactory, PeerConnection and media tracks; KMP calls a bounded typed NAPI/C bridge.

not_yet_proven: LiveKit SDP/ICE and protobuf signaling mapped to the host PeerConnection
remote and local VideoTrack rendering into CMP/XComponent
permission denial and asynchronous capture failure propagated back to KMP state
required_target_checks: Confirm required ABI is arm64-v8a unless x64 evidence is added
Declare and dynamically request CAMERA/MICROPHONE permissions as used
Keep WebRTC objects in the ArkTS host and expose a typed bridge

Run publish, HAP build, package inspection and physical-device runtime checks

known_build_observations: The HAR may emit non-fatal resource-name collision warnings with Compose resources.
The packaged arm64 libohos_webrtc.so is approximately 10 MB, so HAP size impact is material.
Repository and published-package license metadata should be reviewed because observed labels differ.
